skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts and methods of mathematical economic modeling.
Apply static comparative analysis tools for economic models.
Understand basic concepts and representation of static optimization models in economics.
Model consumer behavior including maximizing utility and minimizing expenditure.
Model profit maximization for competitive and monopolistic firms.
Apply mathematical skills to model microeconomic and macroeconomic issues.
Evaluate the impact of exogenous variables on endogenous variables in economic models.
Set up optimization models for consumer behavior including utility maximization and expenditure minimization.
Analyze production behavior and optimization in production and supply.
Demonstrate initiative in learning and research.
Proactively choose and solve economic problems using modeling techniques.
